<function name="SpawnMenuOpened" parent="SANDBOX" type="hook">
	<description>Called when the spawnmenu is opened.

This is an alias of <page>GM:OnSpawnMenuOpen</page> but will **not** be called if <page>SANDBOX:SpawnMenuOpen</page> prevents the spawnmenu from opening.

This hook **will** be called even if the spawnmenu doesn't actually exist, i.e. <page>SANDBOX:SpawnMenuEnabled</page> blocked its creation.

</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
